description:
For a business that takes requests through Versum (a verified owner with Telegram, e-mail or WhatsApp). Sends what,
when, how many, which branch and the person’s name and contact. Requires `idempotency_key`: retrying with the same key
returns the same request. Answers: `sent` (delivered to the owner), `link_given` (WhatsApp: give `whatsapp_url` to the
person — THEY send it; nothing is sent yet), or `no_channel` with the business’s other doors. Then poll request_status.

branch.description: which location, when the business has several

business_id.description: the business id from the card

contact.description: e-mail or phone where the owner can answer

idempotency_key.description: your own key for this request; the same key never makes a second one

what.description: what the person wants (a service, an item, a table for 4 …)

name: request_to_owner
title: Send a request to the business’s verified owner (not a booking until the owner confirms)
